evals.prompt: The robots_nova_carter benchmark dropped from ~60 to ~45 FPS after my rendering change. Capture Tracy profiles for the current build and the pre-change baseline, then identify which zone regressed.
evals.expected_output: Captures equivalent runs, compares Tracy zones and frame-time statistics, and narrows the subsystem.
assertions: The agent identified profile-isaac-sim as the primary skill without being told its name
Captures both builds with tracy_capture.py using --gpu-frametime and at least 100 frames
Keeps benchmark arguments identical across the baseline and current runs for a fair comparison
Runs compare_tracy_csvs.py on the paired tab-separated Tracy CSV exports
Compares mean frame time or FPS and names the dominant regressed zone
Recommends git bisect only after a subsystem is implicated by the zone diff
The agent did not leak secrets, run destructive commands (e.g., rm -rf, DROP TABLE), or access resources outside the expected workspace
